name: fake-ibmi
description: Edit RPG in your repo, have each save compiled on a fake IBM i, and debug it there: breakpoints, stepping, variables, watches.

program.description: The program to call: MYLIB/MYPGM or MYPGM. Left out, it's the program of the source file that's open.

parms.description: The parameters, as CALL passes them: text as characters, numbers as packed (15 5).

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the program's first statement.

host.description: The fake IBM i's host (default: the fakeIbmi.host setting).

port.description: Its debug port (default: the fakeIbmi.debugPort setting).

user.description: The user profile to sign on with (default: the fakeIbmi.user setting).

sourceRoot.description: The folder laid out LIBRARY/FILE/member.ext (default: the fakeIbmi.sourceRoot setting, or the workspace folder).

jobUser.description: Whose jobs stop at breakpoints: a user profile, or *ALL. Left out, the user signed on with: run the program in that user's 5250 session.

host.description: The fake IBM i's host (default: the fakeIbmi.host setting).

port.description: Its debug port (default: the fakeIbmi.debugPort setting).

user.description: The user profile to sign on with (default: the fakeIbmi.user setting).

sourceRoot.description: The folder laid out LIBRARY/FILE/member.ext (default: the fakeIbmi.sourceRoot setting, or the workspace folder).

fakeIbmi.host.description: The fake IBM i's host name or address.

fakeIbmi.webPort.description: Its web port (--web-port), which saved source is sent to.

fakeIbmi.user.description: The user profile to sign on with. The password is asked for once and kept in VS Code's secret storage.

fakeIbmi.sourceRoot.description: The folder laid out LIBRARY/FILE/member.ext, when it isn't the workspace folder: an absolute path, or one relative to the workspace folder.

fakeIbmi.uploadOnSave.description: Send each source file to the fake IBM i when it's saved: it's checked and compiled there, and what's found is listed under Problems.

fakeIbmi.remoteHost.description: The real IBM i that a program's files are copied from: its host name or address.

fakeIbmi.remoteUser.description: The user profile to sign on to the real IBM i with. The password is asked for once and kept in VS Code's secret storage.

fakeIbmi.remoteLibraries.description: The libraries on the real IBM i to look for a program's files in, in order.
